text:
The plate looks like a paper plate of about 23 cm (roughly 260 px wide in the image). The food is sliced sausage, possibly kielbasa or andouille: about 3 round slices and 3 or 4 diagonal or halved pieces, so around 6 pieces.

Each piece is about 3.5 cm across, with slices about 1.5 cm thick. A round slice is therefore about π × 1.75² × 1.5 ≈ 14 cm³, or about 15 g. Six to seven pieces come to roughly 90-100 g.

Smoked sausage has about 300 kcal per 100 g, so 95 g is about 280 kcal.
